_about: Sound script for the docs videos: no voice, only sound effects and a music bed, made with ElevenLabs. `sounds` are generated once (sound.sh gen), `videos` place them on the timeline of the cut MP4 (sound.sh mix). Times are seconds in the cut video. Re-time the cues after a new recording.

music.prompt: Calm lo-fi instrumental for a software tutorial: warm Rhodes chords, soft brushed drums, round upright bass, 82 bpm, steady and unobtrusive, no vocals, no big drops, clean ending

keys.prompt: Soft mechanical keyboard typing at a steady medium pace, close mic, dry room, no music

enter.prompt: One soft mechanical keyboard Enter key press, close mic, dry

tick.prompt: Very short soft UI confirmation tick, warm wooden click

chime.prompt: Gentle two-note success chime, warm marimba, quiet and short

done.prompt: Warm three-note rising success chime, soft marimba and bell, satisfying but gentle

ff.prompt: Smooth airy tape fast-forward whirr, soft and steady, low hiss, no clicks

swish.prompt: Very soft short paper swish, a page turning, subtle

appear.prompt: Soft airy pop as a panel appears on screen, subtle UI sound

scenes.title: 1. Install the engine
scenes.screen: Types '# 1. Install the engine', then 'brew install nijicha/tap/walkie'. Homebrew downloads and installs walkie.

scenes.title: Setup
scenes.screen: 'walkie setup' downloads the Thai voice model; 'Mai is ready'.

scenes.title: 2. Install the plugin
scenes.screen: Clears. Adds the nijicha/skills marketplace, installs walkie@nijicha-skills.

scenes.title: 3. Check that it works
scenes.screen: walkie version → 0.1.1-alpha; claude mcp list → plugin:walkie:walkie Connected.

scenes.title: Smoke test
scenes.screen: walkie smoke records a static page (sped up 4x), test passes, the MP4 is written.

scenes.title: A change to show
scenes.screen: git log: 'Guests can edit the name on their ticket'. Starts claude, trusts the folder.

scenes.title: Ask for a walkie
scenes.screen: Types: 'Make a walkie of the last commit…'. Claude hands it to the walkie subagent.

scenes.title: Storyboard
scenes.screen: Fast-forward (10x) while the subagent writes the storyboard, then the table: steps, captions, Thai narration.

scenes.title: Approve, record
scenes.screen: Types 'Looks good, record it'. Fast-forward (24x) through the recording.

scenes.title: Contact sheet
scenes.screen: Claude's review of the contact sheet: what it checked, three small notes.

scenes.title: The MP4 and PR text
scenes.screen: Types 'Keep it as is. Give me the MP4 and the PR text'. PR text with the storyboard table and 'Made with Walkie'.
